name: real_leo_history
title: Real LEO (TLE history)
description: A week of real Space-Track element sets (gp_history, every object in LEO), with the same six operators as Real LEO. The truth is the nearest element set at each moment, blended across each switch; every twin predicts from the newest set already published, so its predictions drift from the truth by the real TLE error, which is measured from the file itself (robust RTN sigma by TLE age, Starlink and everyone else separately) and drives the Foster Pc. An operator knows its own satellites precisely. Agreed avoidance manoeuvres are applied to the truth as small along-track burns, and real manoeuvres show up as jumps between published element sets. The clock runs through the file's real dates and stops at the end.
